title: RTMO
description: OpenMMLab's RTMO (t, s, m, l): real-time one-stage multi-person 2D pose; finds people and their 17 COCO keypoints in one pass over the image, no person detector needed. Apache-2.0.

Details
  • Paper: RTMO: Towards High-Performance One-Stage Real-Time Multi-Person Pose Estimation, CVPR 2024, 2023-12-12
  • Original code: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose at 5408bc76f5b8
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/open-mmlab/mmpose/blob/5408bc76f5b848cf925a0d1857899011d8c5b497/README.md#license
  • Training data: COCO 2017 (train, instance annotations), AI Challenger human keypoints (2017), CrowdPose, MPII Human Pose, sub-JHMDB (J-HMDB), Halpe-FullBody, PoseTrack 2018 (body7: COCO, AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe and PoseTrack18 keypoints; the CSPDarknet backbone starts from a YOLOX COCO detection checkpoint)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.1 (0.0 to 1.0)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: rtmo-t, rtmo-s, rtmo-m, rtmo-l
  • Outputs: keypoints, keypoint_scores, boxes, scores; label_set: coco-keypoints-17
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): rtmo-t 3000x4000 (0.4 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rtmo-s 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rtmo-m 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.5 reserved); rtmo-l 3000x4000 (0.5 GiB peak allocated, 0.6 reserved)
  • rtmo-t 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 16 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 37 s (ONNX + engine).
  • rtmo-s 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 15 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 37 s (ONNX + engine).
  • rtmo-m 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 18 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 39 s (ONNX + engine).
  • rtmo-l 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 19 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 40 s (ONNX + engine).
  • rtmo-t original (fp32) 1080x1920: mmpose 1.3.2 inference_bottomup (CPU cv2 letterbox, network, NMS, decode), all in the timed call
  • rtmo-t original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; mmpose 1.3.2 inference_bottomup (CPU cv2 letterbox, network, NMS, decode), all in the timed call
  • rtmo-s original (fp32) 1080x1920: mmpose 1.3.2 inference_bottomup (CPU cv2 letterbox, network, NMS, decode), all in the timed call
  • rtmo-s original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; mmpose 1.3.2 inference_bottomup (CPU cv2 letterbox, network, NMS, decode), all in the timed call
  • rtmo-m original (fp32) 1080x1920: mmpose 1.3.2 inference_bottomup (CPU cv2 letterbox, network, NMS, decode), all in the timed call
  • rtmo-m original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; mmpose 1.3.2 inference_bottomup (CPU cv2 letterbox, network, NMS, decode), all in the timed call
  • rtmo-l original (fp32) 1080x1920: mmpose 1.3.2 inference_bottomup (CPU cv2 letterbox, network, NMS, decode), all in the timed call
  • rtmo-l original 1080x1920: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; mmpose 1.3.2 inference_bottomup (CPU cv2 letterbox, network, NMS, decode), all in the timed call
  • rtmo-t load / first call: original 0.26 s / 0.324 s, portable 0.11 s / 0.411 s, kernels 1.38 s / 0.279 s
  • rtmo-s load / first call: original 0.27 s / 0.076 s, portable 0.12 s / 0.412 s, kernels 1.37 s / 0.264 s
  • rtmo-m load / first call: original 0.37 s / 0.077 s, portable 0.22 s / 0.428 s, kernels 1.43 s / 0.242 s
  • rtmo-l load / first call: original 0.55 s / 0.063 s, portable 0.36 s / 0.243 s, kernels 1.52 s / 0.16 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Bottom-up on all 5,000 validation images, no ground-truth boxes; people ranked by their predicted person score, after model-specific decoding; pycocotools OKS AP. Bottom-up on the same every-tenth-image subset for all modes, ranked by predicted person score after model-specific decoding; pycocotools OKS AP. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.014 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.47 and p99 <= 9.8 (absolute error of the output keypoints).

Limitations

  • module() exports the letterboxed-image network and raw per-cell head outputs; coordinate decoding and NMS remain outside the exported graph.
  • Float16 and float32 can retain different people near the score threshold.
